title: Individual risk profiling for portable devices using a neural network to process the cognitive reactions and the emotional responses to a multivariate situational risk assessment
reasoning: The paper proposes a system to profile human risk tolerance and worthiness using neural networks to analyze psychometric responses and facial expressions. While the test includes questions about ethics and values, it is designed to evaluate human subjects for financial services rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical or moral reasoning in AI models or LLMs.
